messages.subject: Instruction - MS-72 seal failure analysis (Harrow Precision)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Dr Trentham,

Further to our call, we would like to instruct Trentham Tribology Laboratory to examine failed and unused Melbourne Sealtech MS-72 cartridge seals from our client Harrow Precision Engineering. The key questions are (1) whether the carbon-graphite face meets grade CG-218 antimony impregnation; (2) whether face flatness is within two helium light bands; and (3) the cause of the premature failures. We will courier 18 failed and 12 unused seals plus drawing HP-400/SEAL Rev C.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti

Elena Marchetti
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

messages.subject: RE: Instruction - MS-72 seal failure analysis (Harrow Precision)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

Happy to assist. Please send the samples and the drawing. I'll run interferometry for flatness and GD-OES for antimony content, plus SEM on the failure surfaces. I understand my duty is to the court. I'd expect a draft report within about six weeks of receiving the samples.

Best wishes,
Helen Trentham
Trentham Tribology Laboratory
